verdict.rationale: mise has no dedicated export feature. Its state already lives in open, user-owned plain-text files: project and global config in `mise.toml` (TOML), env vars from `.env` files, tasks as standalone bash script files, and a committed lockfile. It also reads asdf `.tool-versions` and idiomatic version files, so the data is portable by design rather than through an explicit export path. missing for 10: a documented export or migration command, evidence of converting mise config back into other tools' formats (e.g. writing `.tool-versions`), explicit portability or offboarding documentation, independent corroboration of leaving mise cleanly.
